items.name: REA
items.summary: Reverse engineering with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. The week's biggest gainer among AI-related repositories, adding about 40K stars in seven days.

items.name: gpu-unlock
items.summary: Your GeForce runs AI at half speed — this unlocks the throttled tensor-core throughput on RTX 20/30/40 cards, up to 2x for FP16/BF16/TF32. Released in mid-October and already near 14K stars.

items.name: VoiceStudio
items.summary: A fully local, open-source ElevenLabs alternative: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing and transcription, all on your own machine.

items.name: security-audit-skill
items.summary: Cloudflare's coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits, producing independently verified, machine-readable findings.

items.name: Impeccable
items.summary: A design vocabulary for your coding agent: steer it toward more polished interfaces, then review the result with critique and audit passes.

items.name: DeepTutor
items.summary: The University of Hong Kong's open-source personalized AI tutor for lifelong learning, adapting its teaching to each learner.

items.name: iFixAi
items.summary: Independent auditing for AI agents — run by a human or by the agent itself to check whether agent behavior is trustworthy.

items.name: DeepSeek Harness
items.summary: DeepSeek's plugin-based agent work framework: everything is a plugin, from tools to capabilities.

items.name: Orca
items.summary: A workbench for working with a fleet of coding agents — Grok Bot, Claude Code and others — run and managed from one place.

items.name: ECC
items.summary: An agent-harness performance optimization system built around skills, memory and security for research-first development workflows.
